summary: A dog companion belonging to a player: an NPC of the game's dog class with an owner and a mode. When its owner leaves, it is removed, or with removedWithOwner false, it waits there until giveTo hands it to someone. The NPC events npcDamage and npcDeath also fire for its body.

id.summary: The dog's network id, the same as its NPC's.

all.exampleLua:
for _, dog in ipairs(kcds.characters.Dog.all()) do
  print(dog.name .. " (" .. tostring(dog.id) .. ") belongs to " .. (dog.owner and dog.owner.nickname) or "nobody")
end

getById.summary: The dog with this network id, or null.
getById.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.fromClient("dog:sit", function(player, payload)
  local dog = kcds.characters.Dog.getById(tonumber((payload and payload.id)))
  if dog and dog.owner == player then
    dog.mode = 0 -- wait
  end
end)

soul.summary: The game soul it was spawned from.

ownerId.summary: The owner's player id, or 0 with no owner.
ownerId.exampleLua:
if dog.ownerId == 0 then
  print(tostring(dog.name) .. " has no owner")
end

owner.exampleLua:
local owner = dog.owner
if owner then
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(owner, tostring(dog.name) .. " is hurt!")
end

removedWithOwner.summary: Whether the dog is removed when its owner leaves, true by default. With false, it stays there with no owner.

mode.summary: The companion mode: 0 Wait, staying put; 1 Follow, the default, trailing the owner and running to catch up; 4 Search, roaming to places within 12 m of the owner; 5 Hunt, running at the nearest living animal within 40 m, chasing it up to 80 m and biting for 12 health per second, as the attacker, or following the owner if none; and 2 Free, 3 Aggressive, 6 Guard and 7 Ambush, which are not implemented yet, so the dog stays put. Assigning sends the order again, and dogModeChanged fires only if the mode differs.
mode.exampleLua:
dog.mode = 4 -- search
kcds.core.Events.on("dogModeChanged", function(changed, mode)
  print(tostring(changed.name) .. " is now in mode " .. tostring(mode))
end)

morale.summary: The dog's morale. The game does not report it yet, so it is always 0.

name.summary: Its name, shown on all players' nameplates. You can assign to it.

dimension.summary: Its dimension, which is the owner's when spawned.

objective.summary: What it is doing: 'waiting', 'following', 'searching', 'hunting', or 'idle' in a mode not yet implemented.

spawn.summary: Spawns a dog for an owner.
spawn.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerCommand", function(player, command)
  if command ~= "dog" or player.dog then
    return
  end
  local dog = kcds.characters.Dog.spawn(player, player.position, player.rotation, "", "Mutt")
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, dog.name .. " follows you.")
end)

giveTo.summary: Changes the owner. null removes the owner.
giveTo.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerCommand", function(player, command, args)
  if command ~= "givedog" or not player.dog then
    return
  end
  local target = nil
  for _, other in ipairs(kcds.players.Player.all()) do
    if other.nickname == args[1] then
      target = other
      break
    end
  end
  if target then
    player.dog:giveTo(target)
  end
end)

destroy.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerCommand", function(player, command)
  if command == "dismissdog" and player.dog then
    player.dog:destroy()
  end
end)
